signIn.refused.title: You are not signed in
signIn.refused.notSetUp: Signing in is not set up on this site yet, so your account cannot open. Contact whoever runs this site.
signIn.refused.noWindow: Your account did not open, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.windowGone: Your account was closed before it answered, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.declined: You did not approve it in your account, so nothing was signed. Press the button again when you are ready.
signIn.refused.expired: The request had expired by the time it reached your account, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.ranOut: The request ran out of time while your account was open, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.answeredTooLate: Your account did answer, but too late: the request had run out of time before this site received it, so you are not signed in. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.unreadable: Your account would not take this request, so nothing was signed. Reload this page and press the button again.
signIn.refused.silent: Your account did not answer, so nothing was signed. It may not have finished opening. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.gaveUp: You stopped waiting, so nothing was signed. Press the button again when you are ready.
signIn.refused.didNotFinish: Signing in did not finish, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.refused: This site could not confirm the signature from your account, so you are not signed in. Press the button again. If it happens again, check you are using the account you signed up with.
signIn.refused.tooMany: There have been too many tries to sign in. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
signIn.refused.tooManyWait_one: There have been too many tries to sign in. Try again in {count} minute.
signIn.refused.tooManyWait_other: There have been too many tries to sign in. Try again in {count} minutes.
signIn.refused.unavailable: Signing in is not available on this site right now. Try again later.
signIn.refused.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached, so nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.

act.refused.title: This did not finish
act.refused.notSetUp: This site is not set up to work with your account yet. Tell whoever runs this site.
act.refused.notSignedIn: You are no longer signed in here. Sign in again and try again.
act.refused.anotherPerson: Someone else has signed in on this browser since. Reload the page.
act.refused.signInAgain: This tab was opened after you signed in, so it cannot confirm your account. Nothing was done. Sign out, sign in again, and try again in this tab.
act.refused.keysDidNotOpen: The keys saved for you did not open with the account that answered. Nothing was done. Use the account you set up with.
act.refused.keysWentBack: The keys saved for you changed on another device. Reload the page and try again.
act.refused.declined: You declined in your account. Nothing was done.
act.refused.expired: The request had expired by the time it reached your account, so nothing was signed or sent for this step. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.noWindow: Your account could not be shown on this page, so nothing was signed or sent for this step. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.windowGone: Your account was closed before it answered, so nothing was signed or sent for this step. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.gaveUp: You stopped waiting for your account. Nothing was done.
act.refused.silent: Your account did not answer and handed this page nothing, so nothing was sent for this step. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.ranOut: The request ran out of time while your account was open, and your account handed this page nothing, so nothing was sent for this step. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.unreadable: Your account would not take this request: it could not read it, or would not pay for what it read. Nothing was signed or sent for this step. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.readRanOut: Something this page needed to read did not answer in time, so this page stopped waiting for it. Nothing more was sent. A step before it in the same action may already have gone through. Reload the page to see where things stand, then try again.
act.refused.payChainUnreadable: Your account could not read the network to find your money, so it paid nothing and nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again. If your connection is working, the network may be unavailable, so try again later.
act.refused.payNotEnough: Your account does not have enough available to pay for this, so it paid nothing and nothing was sent. Add to your account or choose a smaller amount, then try again.
act.refused.payNotAsApproved: Your account stopped before paying, because what it was about to pay did not match what you approved. It paid nothing and nothing was sent. Try again. If it happens again, stop and contact support before paying from here.
act.refused.feeNotPaid: The fee for this step could not be paid just now. Nothing was lost. You can try the step again.
act.refused.networkRefused: The network refused this step just now. Nothing was sent and nothing was lost. You can try the step again.
act.refused.payDidNotFinish: Your account could not finish the payment you approved. It paid nothing and nothing was sent. Try again.
act.refused.noKeysHere: This company is not set up for your account on this device. Open it on the device where you created or joined it.
act.refused.committeeDisagrees: What this service asks the super admins to sign does not match what your account reads from the network, so nothing was sent. Reload the page, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.nothingToSign: There is nothing for you to sign. The other super admins sign the rest.
act.refused.nothingSent: Nothing was sent and nothing was spent. Try again, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached, so we cannot tell whether this went through. Reload the page to see where things stand before you try again.
act.refused.didNotFinish: It did not finish. Try again, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.noSeat: Your seat on this company is not on the company's records this device opened, so your records key was not signed and your vault keys were not given. Reload the page; if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.notYourSeat: The seat the company's records name for you is not the one your own key makes, so your records key was not signed and your vault keys were not given. Nothing was sent. Contact support.
act.refused.entryNotFiled: The company's directory has not taken your entry yet, so your vault keys were not given. Open the company again, then try again.
act.refused.entryWaitsForItsInvitation: Your seat's entry has to carry the invitation a signer made for you, and this device could not read it, so your vault keys were not given. Ask the signer who added you to open the company or invite you again.
act.refused.seatUnknown: The company's directory, as this device reads it, holds no seat under your keys, so no vault was built and nothing was sent. Open the company again. If it still holds none, ask the signer who added you.
act.refused.seatNotBelieved: This device does not believe your seat in the company's directory, so no vault was built and nothing was sent. Open the company again to read it afresh. If it happens again, ask a signer to check your seat.
act.refused.seatMayNotRaise: Your seat's role may not raise proposals, and setting up a vault raises two, so no vault was built and nothing was sent. A signer whose role may raise proposals creates the vault.
act.refused.committeeUnread: Your account could not say who holds your company's account, so no vault was built and nothing was sent. Open your account and try again.
act.refused.committeeNotInstallable: The super admins, as your company's account holds them now, cannot hold a vault, so no vault was built and nothing was sent. Ask a super admin to correct who they are and how many must approve, then try again.
act.refused.pageOutOfDate: This page is out of date and cannot build a vault, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
act.refused.vaultNotTheCompanys: A vault was sent, but this device could not read it as one your company holds, so it is not set up and this app puts no money into it. Reload the page and try again. If it still cannot be read, create a new vault.
act.refused.rosterNotBelieved: Could not check the company's signers. Nothing was sent. Reload; if it stays, a signer opens it on their own device.
act.refused.notOpenedYet: Not opened yet. Your wallet did not open this company, so nothing was done. Press again and approve it in your wallet window.
company.notOpenedYet.switcher: Not opened yet. Open it with your wallet from the home page.
act.refused.vaultInfoRefused: The vault's name or description was not accepted, so nothing was sent. A name is 1 to 64 characters on one line, and a description is up to 1,000 characters. Change it and try again.
